narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>If I take out a value below the median, the median goes down.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Take one, two, three, where the median is two, and take out one.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Two and three are left, and their median is two and a half, so it went up.
